symptom: after `drop` removed a Data grid 2's last control-bar button, describe printed no `controlbar` and every route back was refused: `insert into controlBar1` ("widget not found", with a DataGrid2-columns hint) and `insert into dataGrid21` ("not a simple container", reported as CustomWidgets$CustomWidget)
cause: the control bar is the grid's filtersPlaceholder widgets-property — a slot with no Name, not a widget — and no dotted address reached a pluggable widget's own slots; describe omits an empty slot, which made the drop look like it deleted the bar (it does not: Widgets [2] stays)
insight: The reporter called it a classic grid; the error's $Type (CustomWidgets$CustomWidget) was the tell that it is a Data grid 2 whose filtersPlaceholder describe spells `controlbar`. Diff the BSON before and after the drop before believing 'the bar was deleted' — the slot survived, describe hid it. Address a slot like a data view footer (`grid.controlbar`), resolving the keyword through the same table describe/create use (moved to mdl/types so the mutator cannot drift from it), and wire the generic ALTER resolver (ResolveAlterTarget) as well as the operation — the first end-to-end run passed the mutator tests and still failed at 'failed to resolve page target'
